kicker.zh: 型号 / 接口 / 材料

intro.en: Find a cable model or material part number, then send it for a custom replacement or original-part sourcing review.
intro.zh: 按成品型号或材料料号查找，提交编号即可沟通兼容替代件制作或原厂件采购。

search_label.en: Find a model or part number

search_placeholder.en: Brand, model, part number or product type
search_placeholder.zh: 输入品牌、型号、料号或产品类型

empty.en: No matching references. Try a brand, full part number or a listed alias.
empty.zh: 未找到匹配项，请尝试品牌、完整料号或已列出的别名。

intro.zh: 一端连接器、另一端浸锡的尾线组件。

intro.en: Connector and wire parts explicitly listed in the selected pigtail BOMs.
intro.zh: 选中尾线原厂 BOM 明确列出的连接材料与线材。

checks_title.en: Six Decisions Behind the Part Number
checks_title.zh: 型号背后的六个选型要点

copy.en: Confirm the exact mating interface, contact count and connector orientation.
copy.zh: 确认具体对插接口、触点数量与接头方向。

copy.en: Set strip length, tinning requirements and exposed-conductor protection.
copy.zh: 定义剥皮长度、浸锡要求及裸露导体防护。

copy.en: Map wire colors or labels to the connector cavities and circuit functions.
copy.zh: 将线色或线号与接头孔位、电路功能逐一对应。

copy.en: For branched variants, define the junction method, branch positions and individual lengths.
copy.zh: 开发分支结构时，明确汇接方式、分支位置与各支长度。

copy.en: Select wire, sleeves and strain relief for the actual installation conditions.
copy.zh: 按实际安装条件选择导线、套管与应力释放结构。

copy.en: Keep the BOM, pin map and free-end preparation aligned with the approved sample.
copy.zh: 使 BOM、针脚定义与自由端处理和确认样品保持一致。

boundary.en: Send the part number, drawing or sample to confirm the replacement configuration and sourcing plan.
boundary.zh: 请提供型号、图纸或样品，具体替代配置与原厂件采购方案按项目确认。

text.en: Send the model or part number to discuss your project.
text.zh: 提交型号或料号，沟通您的定制与采购需求。
